display_long_description:
Plonk! A 4D Puzzle is a time-bending Mixed Reality game that reshapes the very concept of a jigsaw puzzle with **two extra dimensions**, space and time. ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎  ‎  ‎ ‎ ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎‎[media]


# ⌚ A Moving Puzzle:
Each puzzle piece holds a slice of an animated diorama. Scrub through time to discover how they all connect.

Plonk the pieces together to solve the level.

[media]

# 🧩 50+ Hand-Crafted Puzzles
Travel across a variety of worlds including playful toys, lush environments, clockwork creations and more.

[media]

# 🖐 Play Your Way
Use hand tracking to solve the puzzle, or grab your controllers.

[media]

# 🏆 Leaderboard and Challenges
Race against the clock and compete for top spots on the global and friends leaderboard. Solve the bonus challenges in each level. 

[media]

**Let’s Get Plonkin’**
